This 3-Day Online program can stop your overthinking and teach you to Master your Mind:
In this 30-minute practice, we’ll:
Build muscle using bodyweight asanas
Increase strength and stamina
Ground the Vata energy through breath and slow holds
End with 7 minutes of calming Anulom Vilom Pranayam to reset your nervous system
Take the Dosha Test inside the video to find out your Ayurvedic body type if you're unsure!
